notable_quotes: The paper links structural construction and photoluminescent properties to the choice of carboxylate anion in the Zn(II)-triazolate series.
IR spectra were reported for compounds 2 and 4, providing spectroscopic characterization of the coordination polymers.
The study synthesized a series of Zn(II)-3-amino-1,2,4-triazolate coordination polymers by varying the carboxylate anions.
